sloka: तौ मुनी तापसश्रेष्ठौ विनीतो ह्यभिवादयत् ।स ताभ्यां पूजितो राजा स्वागतेनासनेन च ॥
transliteration: tau munī tāpasaśreṣṭhau vinīto hyabhivādayat ।sa tābhyāṁ pūjito rājā svāgatenāsanena ca ॥

translations.english: The king (Rama) humbly greeted those two sages, the best among ascetics, and was honored by them with a welcome and a seat.
